intro: Saints Bar and Restaurant at St. Kevin's clubhouse is now open — good food, a warm welcome, and the match always on. Open to members and the wider community alike.
hours: Sample opening hours below — to be confirmed by the bar. Check the club's socials for this week's times.
menuNote: Every item on the menu is also available for takeaway — call 087 004 5213 to order. All of our beef and pork is 100% Irish. Gluten-free options available. Gift vouchers available.
